mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`lab_id`, v.`name`, v.`description`, v.`usage_rules`, v.`reserve_value`, v.`confirm_value`, v.`resource_mode`, sv.`quota` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_resource v LEFT JOIN tb_resource_quota sv ON v.id = sv.resource_id WHERE v.lab_id = #{labId} AND v.status = 1
